identitySignals: Name matches registered nonprofit 'Refugee & Immigrant Transitions', EIN 94-3112099, San Francisco, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda location San Francisco, CA

OUSD's own Fremont High School page lists Refugee & Immigrant Transitions (RIT) as a community partner running programs for refugee and immigrant students, matching the Fremont and Castlemont services agreements

Organization website (reftrans.org) describes education, family engagement and community leadership programs for newcomers, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' and English Language Learner department contracts
research.notes: Mailing address left null: reftrans.org does not show one; the Alameda County Newcomers directory lists an Oakland address (1811 11th Ave) that could not be reconciled with the San Francisco HQ. No CA SOS or SAM.gov lookup done.

profile.summary: A nonprofit based in San Francisco that works with people who have sought refuge in the United States. It offers free education, family engagement, and community leadership programs for refugees and immigrants across the Bay Area. It was founded in 1982.
